questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Dublin?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Republic of Ireland is Dublin.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Republic of Ireland?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Republic of Ireland article.

questions.prompt: Which continent is Republic of Ireland in?

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Republic of Ireland on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Republic of Ireland on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.proof: Republic of Ireland is in Europe.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Republic of Ireland about 69,797 square kilometres; Denmark about 42,925 square kilometres; Luxembourg about 2,593 square kilometres; Mauritius about 2,040 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Republic of Ireland?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Republic of Ireland on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Republic of Ireland article.

questions.proof: It shares a border with Northern Ireland (which is part of the United Kingdom).

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia: Republic of Ireland
